authority: Task 2 controller ruling; technical conventions, not scientific approval by the project author
parity_target: Gao supplement equations 1-3; simultaneous Euler-Maruyama update with supplied Gaussian innovations
not_targets: exact reproduction of Gao simulation batches
monthly incidence matching archived infected-state features

sources.availability: Archive and supplement are absent locally; hashes and summaries transcribed from the frozen source record, without a new download

fixture.provenance: Self-generated arithmetic evidence; Decimal precision 60, analytic principal square root of equation 3; no production simulator or upstream arrays used
fixture.license: Project-generated fixture under repository MIT license; no upstream data redistributed
fixture.label_semantics: T/N identify fixed source scenarios; beta is evaluated at source t=500 for T and t=0 for N; one step does not establish a transition

equations.dem_diffusion: Principal symmetric nonnegative square root of dem_covariance; no extra sigma factors; the zero matrix has square root zero
equations.step: maximum(state + drift*dt + diffusion @ gaussian*sqrt(dt), 0); all coefficients use the same left endpoint
equations.projection: Componentwise lower clipping only; no random reset, upper clipping or carried state between replicates; report clipped coordinate counts and fractions

source_profile.origin: Fixed implementation conventions using documented predecessor scales; not the unknown Gao batch parameters
source_profile.burn_in_reset: Start each replicate at initial_state; burn-in uses independent preceding innovations; retain its terminal state, then reset the clock to zero
source_profile.crossing_rule: Continuous equality beta=beta_critical with beta>beta_critical immediately afterward; N has no crossing; do not select the second sampled exceedance
source_profile.window_N_rule: Matched fixed endpoint, an implementation convention replacing the unknown archived sampled endpoints

physical_mapping.origin: Implementation convention only; not established by Gao or the predecessor
physical_mapping.rate_conversion: t_source=t_days/28; beta_day(t_days)=beta_source(t_days/28)/28, so its linear slope divides by 28^2; other rates divide by 28 and white/env amplitudes divide by sqrt(28); demographic covariance uses the converted rates
physical_mapping.consequence: The 1500-unit source experiment is not an 11-year epidemic; the monthly profile below is a separately parameterized adaptation, not a time-rescaled reproduction

population_conversion.origin: recruitment/mortality for algebraic frequency conversion, not a bound on S+I
population_conversion.beta_frequency: 100 * beta_mass per source unit; preserves beta_mass*S*I exactly

archived_characterization.observable: 400 observations of infected state I; not incidence or monthly counts
archived_characterization.CV: sample SD / mean, unscaled; supplement percent values divide by 100
archived_characterization.criterion: Verify original bytes, archived row labels and all six T/N median pairs; AR1(T)>AR1(N) for all noises; CV(T)<CV(N) for white and CV(T)>CV(N) for env/dem
archived_characterization.missing_archive: A requested archival parity gate must fail explicitly if the archive is unavailable; stored summaries alone are not a fresh archive reproduction
archived_characterization.historical_gate_scope: Qualifies the all-noise directional CV requirement for technical source characterization only; scientific replacement is pending ratification

monthly_profile.origin: HEADD implementation conventions; these are not Gao facts or fitted epidemiological parameters
monthly_profile.population_semantics: Fixed effective denominator, not census population or a hard bound on fluctuating S+I; recovery removes I from the modeled subsystem
monthly_profile.burn_in: Null beta and endemic/seasonal parameters; independent preceding innovations; reset initial states for every replicate and share burn-in across outbreak/twin

parameter_definitions.mortality: 1/365 per day, effective turnover rather than human life expectancy

monthly_profile.beta_rule: beta_frequency = R0 * (recovery+mortality); lambda_i = beta_i * sum_j(C_ij*I_j/N_j); equivalent single-region beta_mass = beta_frequency/N
monthly_profile.ramp_rule: Seed only, linear in elapsed days from week*7; constant before/after endpoints; N and twin keep beta_start everywhere

noise.demographic_covariance: Use the same equation-3 covariance with adapted recruitment, mortality, recovery and total infection flow

monthly_profile.endemic_flow: nu_i(t)*S_i added to infection flow, transferring S to I; total f_i=(lambda_i+nu_i(t))*S_i
monthly_profile.seasonal_rule: nu_i(t) = nu_i * (1 + 0.1*cos(2*pi*t/365.25)); no seasonal multiplier on beta
monthly_profile.calendar: Gregorian dates at midnight, leap days included; union of start-anchored 7-day boundaries and month boundaries, including final endpoint; burn-in starts at t=-365 days and also splits at these boundaries
monthly_profile.partial_intervals: Every adjacent boundary pair is one Euler-Maruyama interval with its actual dt and an independent standard Gaussian pair scaled by sqrt(dt); interval lies in exactly one month; no discarded day or reused full-week increment
monthly_profile.latent_incidence: max(total infection flow at the left endpoint, 0)*actual_dt; sum flows within each calendar month, never sum I; demographic innovation is not an extra case event
monthly_profile.integerization: Once per region-month: floor(L) + (u_round < L-floor(L)); no per-step rounding
monthly_profile.observation: Binomial integerized incidence with theta, implemented by inverse CDF at u_observe in (0,1); theta=0 gives zero and theta=1 gives all trials
monthly_profile.innovations: Preallocate fixed arrays by (replicate,calendar_interval,region,S_or_I), and by (replicate,month,region,round_or_observe); separate burn-in block. Twin uses identical arrays, including rounding and binomial quantiles; never consume RNG conditionally
monthly_profile.seed_onset: Month containing the continuous R0=1 crossing followed by R0>1, not a second sampled exceedance; -1 for N
monthly_profile.remote_onset: First observed outbreak-minus-twin count strictly greater than 2*SD; SD is sample SD (ddof=1) of the twin's first 60 observed months, frozen; SD=0 uses strictly positive excess; absent=-1
monthly_profile.diagnostic_T_window: 12 observed months immediately before seed onset, excluding onset; invalid if fewer than 12 months are available
monthly_profile.diagnostic_N_window: Same 12 calendar months as the paired T design; no search for a favorable endpoint

layer1.absorbing_boundary: For the epidemic-only component, I=0 with zero local/imported infection pressure remains zero even under additive white noise; this is an explicit monthly adaptation, not source-equation parity

endemic_calibration.origin: Technical convention for later coupled implementation; not executed in Task 2
endemic_calibration.target: Per-region median of real counts in months 0-59 only
endemic_calibration.fit: Independent single-region nulls at epsilon=0, fixed N/theta/rates/noise; bisection in nu using common innovations across candidates
endemic_calibration.summary: Median over all 128*60 simulated training counts
endemic_calibration.failure: If endpoints do not bracket the target within tolerance or iterations fail, report calibration failure; no widening or evaluation-data fitting
endemic_calibration.output: Save nu, targets, errors, input/config/code hashes and seeds in data/processed; nu/theta are not separately identifiable from medians

validation.seed_tree: SeedSequence(42).spawn(3): source=0, monthly=1, endemic_calibration=2. Source/monthly spawn six cells ordered white:T,white:N,env:T,env:N,dem:T,dem:N; each cell spawns 64 replicates. Calibration spawns 13 canonical regions, each spawning 128 replicates. Record entropy and spawn_key
validation.features: SD ddof=1; CV=SD/mean; AR1=Pearson correlation of adjacent observations; no detrending; zero mean/variance yields zero with validity=false and is excluded from median with valid counts reported
validation.one_step_gate: All six fixture rows within absolute tolerance 1e-10; demographic B@B.T equals equation-3 covariance, with no sigma scaling; separately test clipping and theta=0/1
validation.monthly_checks: 132 nonnegative integer counts; calendar coverage and flow conservation; reproducibility, no future-data use, explicit projection diagnostics; no scientific separation result asserted by this fixture
validation.separation: Preserve archived labels/median directions as the source characterization target. Fresh source and monthly simulation medians/valid counts are diagnostics, not required to match archive medians or reverse white CV. Never tune profile or seeds to pass a direction check
validation.scientific_gate: G4 pending until explicit scientific ratification and applicable evidence; E0_star/FAR failures remain unchanged; interpretation_allowed=false
